title: Y, Z
summary: Learn Y, Z, then practise with the keys you already know.
intro: Learn Y, Z, then practise with the keys you already know.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press y to type Y. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: YY YYf fYf YYYf Yf fYYY YfY

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press z to type Z. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: ZZZ Zj jZ ZjZZ jZZ ZZ ZZZZ jjZZ

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
screens.content: YY ZYW YZ ZZY YYZZ YYZ YZYY YYZY ZZZ YZYZ YWY ZZZY YZZ ZZ YYY

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
screens.content: YYYZ YZ YYY YZYY ZY ZYYZ ZZY ZZ Y9 YYZ ZYZ ZZZ YY YZZ ZZZY
